description: Time series of a single named metric across periods, with month-over-month and year-over-year change per point (value, change, change_percentage, yoy_change, yoy_change_percentage, compared_period). The metric is one bucket (revenue, other_income, cogs, opex, depreciation, financial, tax), one derived P&L aggregate (gross_margin, ebitda, ebit, ebt, net_income) or one P&L category from tenant_config.pnl_labels. get_periodic_summaries returns all metrics of a period at once (including sort_order and include_previous); compute_aggregates covers account/cost-center/category sums with grouping, share or cumulative but cannot compute the derived aggregates (ebitda etc.). Time range: `periods` (a count of the most recent periods, default 12) or `date_from`/`date_to`; not a period list as in other tools.

date_from.description: Alternative to `periods`: start of a date range (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM), independent of date_to.

date_to.description: Alternative to `periods`: end of a date range (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM), independent of date_from.

granularity.description: Time bucket of the returned figures: 'month' (default), 'quarter', 'year' or 'total'. The tool rolls the months up itself.

metric.description: Metric name: one of "revenue", "other_income", "cogs", "opex", "depreciation", "financial", "tax" (buckets) or "gross_margin", "ebitda", "ebit", "ebt", "net_income" (aggregates), or any P&L category name from tenant_config.pnl_labels.

organization_id.description: ID of the organization this call runs in (from list_organizations). Required for tools that change data when you belong to more than one organization. Read tools use the active organization when omitted. Does not change the active organization.

periods.description: Number of most recent periods to include (default 12). A count, not a period list.

name: get_metric_trend
